vars.name: PORT
vars.description: Port the web UI listens on in the Docker image.

vars.name: DATA_DIR
vars.description: Where Termix keeps its database, keys, plugins and uploads. Mount a volume here. Outside Docker the default is ./db/data.

vars.name: ALLOW_EMPTY_DATA_DIR
vars.description: Start even when DATA_DIR is empty but an older data folder exists elsewhere. Only set this if you really want a fresh install.

vars.name: PUID
vars.description: User id the container runs as. Match it to the owner of your data volume.

vars.name: PGID
vars.description: Group id the container runs as.

vars.name: BASE_PATH
vars.description: Serve Termix under a sub path, like /termix. Set the same path in your reverse proxy.

vars.name: NODE_ENV
vars.description: Set by the image. Leave it alone.

vars.name: VERSION
vars.description: Set by the image to the Termix version. Leave it alone.

vars.name: SETTINGS_CACHE_REFRESH_SECONDS
vars.description: How often each server instance reloads admin settings from the database. 0 turns the refresh off.

vars.name: SSH_AUTH_SOCK
vars.description: SSH agent socket used for hosts set to agent auth when they do not name their own socket.

vars.name: ENABLE_SSL
vars.description: Serve HTTPS. Termix makes a self-signed certificate on first boot unless you give it one.

vars.name: SSL_PORT
vars.description: Port for HTTPS.

vars.name: SSL_CERT_PATH
vars.description: Certificate file for HTTPS.

vars.name: SSL_KEY_PATH
vars.description: Private key file for HTTPS.

vars.name: SSL_DOMAIN
vars.description: Domain put in the self-signed certificate.

vars.name: TERMIX_SSL_TERMINATED_BY_NGINX
vars.description: Set by the image when nginx serves HTTPS in front of the backend.

vars.name: DATABASE_DIALECT
vars.description: sqlite, postgres or mysql.

vars.name: DATABASE_URL
vars.description: Connection URL for postgres or mysql, like postgres://user:pass@db:5432/termix.

vars.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX
vars.description: Most connections Termix opens to postgres or mysql.

vars.name: DATABASE_SSL
vars.description: TLS for postgres or mysql: require, no-verify or disable.

vars.name: DB_FILE_ENCRYPTION
vars.description: Encrypt the SQLite file at rest. Set false only if something else already encrypts the disk.

vars.name: DB_FILE_KEY
vars.description: Only used to open SQLite files encrypted by very old versions. You almost never need it.

vars.name: DATABASE_LAYER_SKIP_PREUPGRADE_BACKUP
vars.description: Skip the backup Termix takes of the data folder before an upgrade changes the database.

vars.name: DATABASE_LAYER_PREUPGRADE_BACKUP_KEEP
vars.description: How many of those upgrade backups to keep.

vars.name: DRIZZLE_MIGRATIONS_DIR
vars.description: Where database migrations are read from. Set by the image.

vars.name: JWT_SECRET
vars.description: Signs sign-in sessions. At least 64 characters. Made for you and saved in DATA_DIR/.env if not set. Also read from JWT_SECRET_FILE.

vars.name: DATABASE_KEY
vars.description: Key for the encrypted SQLite file, 64 hex characters. Made for you if not set. Also read from DATABASE_KEY_FILE.

vars.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
vars.description: Wraps the data keys that encrypt passwords and SSH keys, 64 hex characters. Made for you if not set. Also read from ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE.

vars.name: INTERNAL_AUTH_TOKEN
vars.description: Token the server uses to call itself. Made for you if not set. Also read from INTERNAL_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE.

vars.name: TERMIX_REQUIRE_EXTERNAL_SECRETS
vars.description: Refuse to start unless the four secrets above come from env vars or _FILE files, so none are written to disk.

vars.name: OIDC_SYSTEM_SECRET
vars.description: Only read to move data from installs older than 2.5. Never change it on an install that has it.

vars.name: WEBAUTHN_SYSTEM_SECRET
vars.description: Only read to move data from installs older than 2.5. Never change it on an install that has it.

vars.name: ALLOW_PASSWORD_LOGIN
vars.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for signing in with a username and password.

vars.name: ALLOW_REGISTRATION
vars.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for creating new accounts.

vars.name: ALLOW_PASSWORD_RESET
vars.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for resetting a password from the sign in page.

vars.name: EXTERNAL_ALLOW_REGISTRATION
vars.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for creating accounts the first time someone signs in with SSO or LDAP.

vars.name: EXTERNAL_FORCE_HTTPS
vars.description: Build sign in callback URLs with https even when the request came in over http. Use it behind a proxy that does not send X-Forwarded-Proto.

vars.name: OIDC_ALLOW_REGISTRATION
vars.description: Old name for EXTERNAL_ALLOW_REGISTRATION. Still read in 26.10.

vars.name: OIDC_FORCE_HTTPS
vars.description: Old name for EXTERNAL_FORCE_HTTPS. Still read in 26.10.

vars.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Read by core only to move a 2.8 OIDC setup into the sso plugin. See the sso plugin for the real variables.

vars.name: OIDC_ENV_OVERRIDE
vars.description: Read by core only to move a 2.8 OIDC setup into the sso plugin. See the sso plugin for the real variables.

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_ENABLED
vars.description: Let a proxy like Authelia or Authentik sign people in by sending their username in a header.

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES
vars.description: Comma separated IPs or CIDRs of the proxies allowed to send the headers. Required when trusted proxy login is on.

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_USERNAME_HEADER
vars.description: Header that holds the username.

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_ROLE_HEADER
vars.description: Header that holds the user's groups or roles.

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_ROLE_MAP
vars.description: JSON map from proxy roles to Termix roles, like {"admins":["admin"],"staff":["user"]}. Required when trusted proxy login is on.

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
vars.description: Comma separated IPs or CIDRs nginx takes the client IP from (X-Forwarded-For). Set it to your reverse proxy.

vars.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
vars.description: Comma separated extra origins allowed to call the API from a browser.

vars.name: TERMIX_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
vars.description: Comma separated extra origins allowed to open WebSockets.

vars.name: HTTP_PROXY
vars.description: Proxy for outbound HTTP requests, like registry downloads and webhooks.

vars.name: HTTPS_PROXY
vars.description: Proxy for outbound HTTPS requests.

vars.name: NO_PROXY
vars.description: Comma separated hosts that skip the proxy.

vars.name: LOG_LEVEL
vars.description: debug, info, warn or error.

vars.name: LOG_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT
vars.description: iso or 24h. Unset uses the local time format.

vars.name: AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.description: Delete audit entries older than this many days. Unset keeps them until the entry cap.

vars.name: AUDIT_LOG_MAX_ENTRIES
vars.description: Most audit entries kept. The oldest go first.

vars.name: AUDIT_LOG_FORWARD_URL
vars.description: Also POST every audit entry as JSON to this URL. Overrides the admin setting.

vars.name: AUDIT_LOG_FORWARD_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token sent with forwarded audit entries.

vars.name: SESSION_RECORDING_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.description: Only read once to carry a 2.8 value into the session-recording plugin.

vars.name: TERMIX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY_URL
vars.description: Use another plugin index instead of the official registry.

vars.name: TERMIX_PLUGIN_STATS_URL
vars.description: Where install counts are read from. Defaults to stats.json next to the registry index.

vars.name: TERMIX_REQUIRE_SIGNED_PLUGINS
vars.description: Only load plugins signed by a trusted key. Blocks uploads of unsigned files even in developer mode.

vars.name: TERMIX_BUNDLED_PLUGINS_DIR
vars.description: Where the plugins shipped with Termix are read from. Set by the image.

vars.name: TERMIX_PLUGIN_PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT
vars.description: Requests per minute one IP may make to a plugin's public routes.

vars.name: PLUGIN_MAX_KV_KEYS
vars.description: Most key value entries one plugin may store.

vars.name: TERMIX_DEV_RELOAD
vars.description: Set by npm run dev so plugin rebuilds reload without a restart.

vars.name: TERMIX_DEV_RUNNER
vars.description: Set by npm run dev.

vars.name: ENABLE_INSECURE_MODE
vars.description: Desktop app only. Skip TLS certificate checks for the linked server. Only for testing.

vars.name: ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU
vars.description: Desktop app only. Set to 1 to turn off GPU acceleration if the window is blank or flickers.

vars.name: TERMIX_LOCAL_SHELL
vars.description: Desktop app only. Shell the local terminal opens, like /bin/zsh or pwsh.exe.

vars.name: SHELL
vars.description: Your login shell, used by the local terminal when TERMIX_LOCAL_SHELL is not set.

vars.name: ELECTRON_EMBEDDED
vars.description: Set by the desktop app when it runs its own backend.

vars.name: TERMIX_DATA_DIR
vars.description: Set by the desktop app to its data folder.

vars.name: XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP
vars.description: Read on Linux to pick the password store and window behavior.

vars.name: DESKTOP_SESSION
vars.description: Read on Linux to pick the password store.

vars.name: VITE_BASE_PATH
vars.description: Base path baked in at build time.
